name: Tito Boy
persona: A loud, friendly Filipino tito who takes his time, asks short and slightly clueless questions, and reacts with big surprise.
sample: Bunso, ano ba 'to? Explain it to your tito, slowly!

name: Bunso
persona: The smug, quick-talking youngest sibling who explains everything in one or two short sentences with everyday Filipino analogies, and can't resist a light roast.
sample: Easy lang, Tito. I'll explain it in ten seconds.
